top_choice_rationale: P003 (Hyman, Brangwynne, Rosen) rests on a new concept, not a tool: multivalent interactions drive liquid-liquid demixing, so membraneless compartments follow polymer and colloid phase thermodynamics. It is reproduced widely, over a decade old, and each name maps to a documented contribution, so the three-name allocation is clean (Pappu and Mittag are the main omission). Residual doubts are contested in-cell physiology and whether it reads as chemistry. I rank P005 (targeted degradation, a transferable design rule) then P004 (base editing, Liu, Komor, Gaudelli, clean first-demonstration record) next, ahead of the two-part P002 and P001, whose cuts (Liu alone, Crews and Handa only; C-N coupling after the 2010 cross-coupling prize) are weaker; no award is last.
recusal_note: No personal or institutional tie to any credited name. My field (lipid and protein self-assembly, amyloid) is adjacent to condensates (P003), which could bias me; I also sit with Lund colleagues Heiner Linke and Peter Somfai, an ordinary colleague connection that does not require recusal.
